name: M3_QMS300MI_GetQIRqByRefOrd
description: Retrieve quality inspection (QI) request header data for a specific reference order. A QI request represents a quality inspection order linked to an item and optionally a lot. This operation locates a single QI request using facility, item, reference order category and reference order number, optionally refined by order line, line suffix, lot, request origin and request status. When the input identifies exactly one QI request, M3 returns the complete header: identity and description data, process status and approval details, required and approved dates, warehouse and lot context, delivery/receiving and order references, supplier and grower agreement references, and reinspection settings.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the QI request is registered, used to identify the correct record.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for which the QI request was created, used as part of the search key.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Reference order category of the order linked to the QI request, such as manufacturing, purchase, or customer order.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number of the order linked to the QI request, used to retrieve the request.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number of the item used as an additional key to identify the QI request.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number of the reference order used as an additional key when locating the QI request.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix or subline sequence on the reference order used to uniquely identify the order line for the QI request.

inputParameters.name: QITY
inputParameters.description: Origin of the QI request (standard, retest, pre-shipment, or agreement), optionally used as a filter when retrieving the request.

inputParameters.name: QSTA
inputParameters.description: Processing status of the QI request (pending, released, in process, completed, replaced, or canceled), optionally used to restrict which request is returned.

outputParameters.name: QRID
outputParameters.description: Unique identifier of the retrieved QI request.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for which this QI request was created.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number associated with the QI request.

outputParameters.name: QSTA
outputParameters.description: Current processing status of the QI request (pending, released, in process, completed, replaced, or canceled).

outputParameters.name: QAPR
outputParameters.description: Approval status of the QI request (pending, approved, or rejected).

outputParameters.name: APDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the QI request was approved.

outputParameters.name: QRDT
outputParameters.description: Required date for the QI request used to determine applicable quality specifications.

outputParameters.name: QRRP
outputParameters.description: QI request ID that replaced this request, for example after lot blending or retest.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Reference order category of the order that triggered the QI request, such as manufacturing, purchase, or customer order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Reference order line number linked to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Reference order line suffix identifying a subline on the reference order linked to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: QITY
outputParameters.description: Origin or reason why the QI request was created (standard, retest, pre-shipment, or agreement).

outputParameters.name: QNXA
outputParameters.description: Next action to be taken in processing the QI request.

outputParameters.name: CEPR
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether a certificate has been printed for this QI request.

outputParameters.name: LPRD
outputParameters.description: Date when a certificate or related document was last printed for this QI request.

outputParameters.name: TXID
outputParameters.description: Identifier of any comments or text attached to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the QI request record was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when the QI request record was created.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the inspected item or lot is stored.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse for the inspected item or lot.

outputParameters.name: CAMU
outputParameters.description: Container number holding the item and lot related to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: RIDI
outputParameters.description: Delivery number associated with the goods covered by the QI request.

outputParameters.name: CALP
outputParameters.description: User who last printed the certificate of analysis for this QI request.

outputParameters.name: QIAP
outputParameters.description: User who approved or rejected the QI request.

outputParameters.name: QIUS
outputParameters.description: Person responsible for managing the QI request.

outputParameters.name: QATM
outputParameters.description: Time when the QI request was approved.

outputParameters.name: REPN
outputParameters.description: Receiving number from goods receiving that is linked to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: RELI
outputParameters.description: Receiving line number associated with the QI request.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number linked to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number on the grower or supplier agreement related to the QI request.

outputParameters.name: SEQN
outputParameters.description: Sequence number used for control and versioning of the QI request record.

outputParameters.name: STRE
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether a standard QI request has been reset to a retest request.

outputParameters.name: QTID
outputParameters.description: Reinspection plan ID governing when the lot should be reinspected.

outputParameters.name: QTSQ
outputParameters.description: Sequence number of the reinspection test within the reinspection plan.
